mentions.name: Harbor
mentions.description: A tool that saves hours when setting up LLMs locally. It pre-integrates over 50 different LLM-related projects and provides a CLI and a Desktop app on top to manage their configs.
mentions.problem: Setting up LLMs locally takes a lot of time, so Harbor streamlines it with pre-integrated projects and config management.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I work on Harbor (https://github.com/av/harbor), it is a project to save hours when setting up LLMs locally.

I pre-integrated over 50 different LLM-related projects, added a nice CLI and a Desktop app on top to manage the configs.
